analysis.rationale: 单步随机噪声。压缩: block_boundary=0.999/unique_G=256 → 排除; 模糊: spectral_slope target=-1.0043 vs clean=-1.0107 (噪声下可靠信号, 差 0.006<0.03) → 排除; poisson (var_slope=-0.55, ric=0.045)/speckle (vm_slope=-4.34)/impulse (zero_ratio=0.0217, impulse sim zero_ratio=0.970) 全部排除。§B 指纹: rgb_ratio=1.63>1.4 + cross_ch_corr=0.293 (YCrCb 理论 0.283, RGB 应≈0) + 每通道残差 std (30.9,22.9,37.3) 与 noise_gaussian_YCrCb sev2 理论 (34.7,23.3,42.2, clipping 下略低) 吻合。对模拟图重跑 run_full_analysis 得到与目标逐项相同的信号 (sigma 14.46=14.46, var_ratio 1.0446 vs 1.0448, chroma 1.2044=1.2044, clip 0.1255=0.1255, bb 0.9982 vs 0.9992), 证明 SATURATION_strengthen_sev3 为噪声导致的假阳性 (step2 _for_step4 can_fake_saturation=true), 实际无 global 步。3 对 support 全部复核 MATCH。噪声步骤按 SKILL 规则永不 LIKELY → UNCERTAIN。
